Trapping is the hunter skill for World 3; you need a trap box equipped to begin trapping
Go to a critter's spawn area and place a trap to start trapping
Higher tier trap means you can put down more traps
Call Me Ash big alchemy bubble allows one extra trap placed
Call Me Ash only needs to be equipped when placing; you can unequip afterwards and the trap stays
Unlock more critters by doing the trap request line in World 3 (left portal from town hub)
Three stats matter: trapping efficiency
explicit: trapping xp and shiny critter chance

statement: When placing a trap only trapping efficiency and trapping xp are snapshotted; shiny chance applies when collecting
You can place traps on all characters and should do so
When placing use only enough efficiency to hit the threshold for extra critters
If you can't hit the extra critter threshold use trapping xp instead
The main stat for trapping is agility
Efficiency thresholds for extra critters can be found on the wiki linked in the pinned comment
Example placing cards: Easy Resource Guard
If you lack those cards alternatives could be agility cards
Equip Skill Dimwit and Unending Energy prayers when placing for extra gains and unequip after since they are snapshotted
Bowman efficiency skill and specialized skill for xp also count for trapping
Natural trap gives much more xp but fewer critters and shinies
Silk skin trap gives far less xp but much higher shiny chance
Each trap has multiple durations; silk skin can be 20 minutes up to a few days
Daily players should set traps for 20 hours so they only handle them once a day
Extra stat changes with duration but not proportionally; sometimes longer times mean fewer gains
Rogue is at Jungle Perimeter; Grabo at Salty Shores; Scorpio at The Ring; Mousey at Rat's Nest; Allio at Hollow Trunk
Pingy at Stache Spit; Bunny at Thermonuclear Climb; Dung Beetle at Efaunt's Tomb; Honker at Wham Wonderland; Blobfish at Cocoa Tunnel
Collecting manually from every trap with every character takes far too long and is not recommended
Use hunter talent Eagle Eye to collect everyone's traps at a reduced rate; level it up to 100
Book Eagle Eye in the library; higher level means less reduction up to full critter gain and nearly full xp
Trapping drone is another collection option explained later
Collecting gives a percent chance for a shiny critter used in many crafting items
When collecting on hunter run full shiny critter chance with Frog
Critter Num Nums skilling food increases critters gained when collecting
Shiny Snitch prayer gives a bundle of 20 shiny critters instead of one
Shiny Snitch curse lowers shiny chance by 15x at level 1
Focus Reflective Eyesight when collecting; it gives timed shiny chance and retriggers every 10 trapping levels
Collecting setup: Frog
column12: Blobfish cards plus card drop chance cards if needed; Critter Num Nums food; Shiny Snitch prayer

statement: Silver trapping ovals suggested for hunter but usable on other characters for more trapping power
Hydrant constellation on second tab gives +20 critters and traps and +10 trap efficiency
Post office trapping box gives trapping efficiency
Trapping xp and shiny critter chance are in the arcade golden ball shop on rotation
Build the Trapper Drone to place and collect in the same place; upgrading gives more critters
Drone is based on your max Eagle Eye level; works on non-hunters and saves walking around the world
To level trapping fast on a character stand at a trap place and use xp balloons
If you have the level but not resources swap your highest tier trap between characters; one huge trap can serve all 10
Spice unlocking sea urchin in the kitchen increases critters from traps; see breeding guide for spices
Future video will cover spice optimization and forager setup for spice gains
Equip Ozo chips in the lab that increase base efficiency and efficiency percent skill before placing traps
There is also a jewel for trapping but it costs lots of gems
